analysis.summary: The document text provided consists entirely of unreadable character encodings and garbled text artifacts. As a result, no legible financial figures, operational metrics, or management commentary can be extracted. Consequently, no specific facts or commitments are reported for this period. Narmada Gelatines reported a 4.89% decrease in revenue from operations to ₹181.79 crores for FY 2023-24, while EBITDA grew by 3.78% to ₹22.87 crores. The company underwent a significant change in promoter ownership, becoming an associate of Pioneer Jellice India Private Limited following a stake sale by Alfamont (Mauritius) Limited.

guidance.claim: India's gelatin market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 2 to 3% annually over the next few years.
guidance.quote: India's gelatin market is projected to register a CAGR of 2 to 3% every year in the next few years.

guidance.claim: The global economy is expected to grow at a pace of 3 to 3.5 percent during 2024 and 2025.
guidance.quote: The Global economy to continue growing at 3 to 3.5 percent during 2024 and 2025, at the same pace as in 2023.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for gelatin is being driven by increasing consumer awareness of health benefits like joint health and skin elasticity.
demand_outlook.quote: Gelatin, being a rich source of collagen, is recognised for boosting joint health, skin elasticity, and hair strength, driving its demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for medicines is expected to rise due to the rapid growth of the global ageing population.
demand_outlook.quote: Owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world, the demand for medicines is expected to increase.

demand_outlook.claim: Changing lifestyles and a preference for convenience foods are driving global gelatin demand.
demand_outlook.quote: There is also increasing demand for convenience food and beverages due to changing lifestyles, increasing working population as consumers lacks the time to prepare home – cooked food and are more inclined towards convenience food products.

demand_outlook.claim: The average selling price of gelatin increased by 3.28% compared to the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Average selling price of gelatine increased by 3.28% but DCP decreased by 5% as compared to last year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is discussing the installation of a 2 MW solar power plant at its factory.
capex_expansion.quote: Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises.

margins_costs.claim: Power and fuel costs decreased by 1.5% due to improved boiler efficiency and lower coal prices.
margins_costs.quote: power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Material consumption reduced by 1% in fiscal 2023-24 due to better yield.
margins_costs.quote: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, which is due to better yield

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs accounted for 8.21% of revenue from operations.
margins_costs.quote: Employee cost stood at 8.21% (7.17% previous year) of revenue from operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Gelatine sales volume decreased by 5% during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume of gelatine / DCP decreased by 5%/ 8%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing good quality crushed bones, the main raw material, is a significant concern for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: Low-cost industrial grade gelatin from China is being imported and sold as human consumption grade, impacting the market.
risks_headwinds.quote: there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in the manufacturing of capsules.

risks_headwinds.claim: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes is a primary barrier to market growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers.

management_commitments.claim: The company is discussing the installation of a 2 MW solar power plant at its factory.
management_commitments.quote: Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.
management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.
